name: Rare Earth
summary: At Dolanaar, Rare Earth waits for delivery to Denalan's camp near Lake Al'Ameth. The mineral-rich soil came from Darnassus for his botanical experiments on Teldrassil.

sections.title: Soil of Darnassus
sections.body: Rare Earth is late reaching Dolanaar from Darnassus. Denalan, an eccentric botanist on Lake Al'Ameth's eastern shore, requested the parcel to study plants in Teldrassil's young ecosystem. Herbalist Syral Bladeleaf now entrusts the soil to travelers heading south, hoping it reaches Denalan before its potency fades.

faq.q: What is Rare Earth used for?
aliases: what does denalan do with rare earth
faq.answer: Denalan, an herbalist and botanical researcher at Lake Al'Ameth, will use Rare Earth in his experiments. He cultivates Teldrassil's native plants with mineral compounds and enriched soils from Darnassus.

faq.q: Who sends the Rare Earth to Denalan?
aliases: where do you get rare earth
faq.answer: Herbalist Syral Bladeleaf holds the package in Dolanaar. It arrived late from Darnassus, and she asks travelers heading south toward Lake Al'Ameth to carry it to Denalan.

faq.q: Why was Denalan worried about the delivery?
faq.answer: The shipment was delayed on its way to Dolanaar, leaving Denalan waiting by the lake. When it arrives, he worries that the soil may have lost the freshness his experiments need.

angles.text: Herbalists can look to Syral Bladeleaf and Denalan, who study how specialized earth changes the growth and properties of Teldrassil's saplings.
As a night elf tending the young World Tree, you can see how experiments at Lake Al'Ameth reveal the ways life adapts to Teldrassil's untamed boughs.
